faq.question: Which regular expression engine does this tool use?
faq.answer: This tool utilizes the native JavaScript RegExp engine. This engine matches the behavior of Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox, and Node.js environments.

faq.question: Are my test strings uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. 99tool.in processes all expression compilations and pattern evaluations locally in your browser memory. Your test strings are never sent over the network.

faq.question: Why does the tool show a regex syntax error?
faq.answer: This message occurs when the expression is mathematically invalid, such as having unclosed parentheses (, unescaped slashes, or duplicate flags.

faq.question: Does the debugger support lookbehinds and lookaheads?
faq.answer: Yes. The browser-native engine supports modern ES2018+ regex features, including positive and negative lookaheads ((?=...) / (?!...)) and lookbehinds ((?<=...) / (?).

word_counter.what_is_title: What is the Online Word Counter?
word_counter.what_is_content:
The Online Word Counter is a real-time text analysis tool that counts words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs as you type or paste content. Cloud-based text editors often store your documents on external servers. This tool performs all analysis locally inside your browser with no data transmission.

The counter updates instantly on every keystroke, letting you monitor text length for essays, social media posts, SEO content, or any format with a character or word limit. Your text never leaves your device.
word_counter.how_to_use_title: How to Use the Online Word Counter
how_to_use_steps: Type or paste your text directly into the editor box at the top of the page.
Watch the Word Count, Character Count, Sentence Count, and Paragraph Count update in real time.
Use the "Reading Time" indicator to estimate how long it will take an average reader to consume your content.
Edit your text directly in the box to adjust length until you meet your target.
Click "Clear" to reset the editor for a fresh analysis.
key_features: Real-Time Counting: Updates word, character, sentence, and paragraph counts on every keystroke.
Reading Time Estimate: Calculates approximate reading duration based on standard adult reading speed.
Character Count (with & without spaces): Displays both totals for platforms like Twitter that count spaces differently.
Zero-Upload Privacy: All counting logic runs client-side; your text is never sent to any server.
common_use_cases: Academic Essays: Verifying word count against submission limits for university assignments before upload.
SEO Content Writing: Targeting specific character counts for meta descriptions, title tags, and article lengths.
Social Media Posts: Staying within Twitter/X or LinkedIn character limits before publishing.
Freelance Writing: Auditing deliverable length against contractual word-count specifications.

faq.question: Does this tool save what I write?
faq.answer: Absolutely not. Your privacy is paramount. Everything happens locally in your browser tab. Once you close it, your text is gone forever from our end (because it was never here in the first place!).

faq.question: What is a good reading speed count?
faq.answer: We use an average estimate of 200 words per minute, which is standard for most adults. It gives you a rough idea of how long it will take someone to finish your article.

faq.question: Can I use this for social media character limits?
faq.answer: Definitely! Whether it's for X (Twitter), LinkedIn, or Instagram captions, the character counter (with and without spaces) is your best friend for staying within those limits.

faq.question: Is there a limit to how much text I can paste?
faq.answer: We haven't found a limit yet! Whether it's a short tweet or a full thesis chapter, the tool is built to handle it effortlessly.

faq.question: Does it work on my phone?
faq.answer: Yes, the tool is fully responsive. You can count words on the go from your smartphone or tablet just as easily as on a desktop.
